protocols.title: Pemvidutide (5 mg) Dosage Protocol — source reference
protocols.purpose: Individual-page schedule and handling details, transcribed as a research/educational reference
protocols.evidenceNotes: Secondary commercial source; the details below are the source's own statements, not independently verified clinical guidance. Trial doses reported: 1.2, 1.8, or 2.4 mg SC once weekly. MASH program used 1.2 and 1.8 mg without titration; 2.4 mg was dropped due tolerability without added liver-fat benefit. Investigational and not approved.

schedule.description: Once weekly in trials. The MASH program used 1.2 or 1.8 mg without titration; 2.4 mg was dropped.

regimen.notes: Trial dose options are not a personal schedule. Development and tolerability context are as described in the source.
